facts.subject: src/melee/ft/kinds/ftCommon/ftCo_Dash.c
facts.old_value: A sufficiently fast horizontal-stick tilt enters Dash when directed with the fighter's facing and enters a smash turn when directed against it. Dash entry installs facing-scaled initial velocity and motion variables; callbacks then expose frame-window-dependent interrupts, exit when animation ends, update grounded movement, and process ground collision.
facts.reason: Correct immediate facing-scaled velocity assignment to a queued, optionally scaled correction.
facts.replacement_value: A sufficiently recent and strong horizontal-stick tilt dispatches Dash when aligned with facing and smash Turn otherwise. Entry initializes motion variables and queues a facing-relative velocity correction in secondary ground acceleration, optionally scaled by ground friction. Callbacks provide frame-window interrupts, animation-expiry dispatch, ground movement and delegated map collision.
